name: std::chrono::tai_clock::now
intro:
Returns a time point representing the current point in time.
The result is calculated as if by std::chrono::tai_clock::from_utc(std::chrono::utc_clock::now()). Implementations may use a more accurate value of TAI time.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A time point representing the current time.

summary: Returns a time point representing the current point in time.
